problem: 1/x + 1/(x-9) = 4/(x^2-9x). What are all the solutions to the given equation?
verified: sympy: x^2-9x=x(x-9); combining fractions gives (2x-9)/(x(x-9))=4/(x(x-9)) -> 2x-9=4 -> x=13/2 (x=0 and x=9 are excluded values, not solutions)

y = -4x^2 - 47; y = qx - 43. In the given system of equations, q is a positive constant. The graphs of the equations in the given system intersect at exactly one point, (x, y), in the xy-plane. What is the value of x?
verified: sympy: setting equal, 4x^2+qx+4=0; exactly one solution requires discriminant q^2-64=0 -> q=8 (positive); then 4x^2+8x+4=0 -> (x+1)^2=0 -> x=-1

problem: 56x^2 + (56s + r)x + rs = 0. In the given equation, r and s are positive constants. The product of the solutions to the given equation is krs, where k is a constant. What is the value of k?
verified: sympy: factors as (56x+r)(x+s)=0, roots -r/56 and -s; product = (-r/56)(-s) = rs/56, so k=1/56
